text: Chief decision on the policy question: index-local recovery when association is provable, fail-closed otherwise. If the outcome sequence has exactly the requested ids in the requested order (or a bijection by id with no missing/duplicate/extra), items whose outcome conforms keep their vectors and each malformed item becomes Estimate.Missing with a typed reason carried in the receipt; any count/duplicate/extra/missing-id defect invalidates the whole batch (no vector may be misassociated). Mutation tests for all five cases.
